title: nvml-mock Helm values
description: Schema for deployments/nvml-mock/helm/nvml-mock/values.yaml. Validated by Helm at install/upgrade time so typos like `mode: healhty` or `probability: 1.5` fail fast with an actionable error instead of silently coercing to healthy / out-of-range behavior at runtime.

profile.description: GPU profile name. The valid set is enforced by the template helper (which renders a friendly error pointing users at gpu.customConfig); we deliberately avoid a JSON-schema enum here so the helper can keep producing that actionable message instead of a generic schema rejection.

count.description: Number of GPUs to expose. Use an integer to force a slice, or the empty string "" (default) to derive the count from the selected profile's devices list.

failureInjection.description: Opt-in GPU failure scenarios. The engine treats `mode: healthy` as a no-op even when enabled, so a bare `enabled: true` does not silently trip every GPU.

mode.description: Failure mode. Anything outside this enum is rejected; the engine has no fall-through coercion path.

probability.description: Per-call trip probability. Must be in [0, 1]; 0 disables stochastic tripping.

after_calls.description: Deterministic trip after N guarded NVML calls. 0 disables this trigger.

seed.description: RNG seed for reproducibility. 0 means time-based (non-deterministic).

code.description: Xid code surfaced via the NVML event set once the device trips. 0 disables Xid emission. Common codes: 79 (fallen off bus), 48 (DBE error), 63 (page retirement).

nodeLabels.description: Node labels nvml-mock causes to exist. setup.sh writes nvidia.com/gpu.present directly; NFD derives pci-10de.present from the node agent's feature file.

featuresDir.description: Host directory NFD's local source reads feature files from. Must be the featureFilesDir the deployed NFD actually reads. Typed as a non-empty string so that an empty string, or a boolean/number/array, is rejected at `helm template` time. An explicit `null` deletes the key and is not caught (there is no `required`), rendering a blank hostPath the API server rejects only at apply time.

allocationWatcher.description: Mirror each pod's nvidia.com/gpu claim into memory.used_bytes (#506).

nri.description: Node-wide ambient injection via containerd NRI.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Pod termination grace period (seconds). Lower values speed up rollouts; preStop cleanup is fast so 5-15s is typical.

updateStrategy.description: DaemonSet rolling update strategy passed verbatim into spec.updateStrategy.

imex.description: IMEX simulation. mockChannels covers the capability surface the NVIDIA DRA driver's compute-domain kubelet plugin reads.

mockChannels.description: Renders a substitute /proc/devices, the fabric-imex-mgmt capability file, and the channel device nodes. Consumed via the DRA driver's altProcDevices value. See NVIDIA/k8s-test-infra#498.

channelCount.description: Number of channel device nodes to create. 2048 matches getImexChannelCount() in the DRA driver's compute-domain kubelet plugin.

channelMajor.description: Character-device major advertised for nvidia-caps-imex-channels. Must differ from capsMajor and must not collide with a major already present on the node; the renderer rejects both cases.

capsMajor.description: Character-device major advertised for nvidia-caps. Must differ from channelMajor.

fabricmanager.description: Fake nvidia-fabricmanager daemon for NVSwitch platforms. When enabled is empty, the chart derives enablement from the GPU profile (NVSwitches or fabric.state: auto).

enabled.description: Tri-state override: empty string derives from profile; true/false force the daemon on or off.

stateDir.description: HostPath directory for the node-local fabricmanager readiness marker.

port.description: TCP port for the mock-ib fabric relay between nvml-mock pods.

networkPolicy.description: NetworkPolicy restricting inbound access to the fabric port to peer nvml-mock pods. No-op on CNIs that do not enforce NetworkPolicy (e.g. Kind's kindnet).

controlPlane.description: Mokka Control Plane. Off by default; renders a Deployment + Service only when controlPlane.enabled is true.

logging.description: Structured-logging knobs. The binary rejects unknown values, so enums here fail fast at helm template time instead of after the pod crashes.

shutdownTimeout.description: Go duration string passed to --shutdown-timeout. Must fit inside terminationGracePeriodSeconds minus the preStop sleep.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Pod-level grace period. Must be >= preStop sleep + shutdownTimeout, otherwise kube SIGKILLs the drain window.
